title: Ad Hoc Teamwork via Offline Goal-Based Decision Transformers
reviewed_version: PMLR 267 published version fetched from supplied mlresearch source URL
summary: Minor headline arithmetic, contradictory PP environment descriptions and incomplete probabilistic specification. The table/curve checkpoint correspondence and historical empirical impact remain Needs Evidence; the original Major inference lacked an established common-evaluation premise.
limitations: No identified author implementation in frozen bounded-discovery record; separate attachment inaccessible.
No author programs or experiments run; raw returns/configs/checkpoints unavailable.
Figure curves compared visually, not digitized; illustrative independent-normal difference intervals are not paired hypothesis tests.

problems.claim: PP8 improvement printed8.01 percent rather than0.8013 propagates into37.83 percent average.
problems.evidence: Recalculation using six strongest displayed baseline means gives36.6331 percent average.
problems.alternative_explanation: Decimal typo in cell explains printed headline average exactly; no alternate stated comparator.
problems.dependency: Magnitude of headline average, not point-estimate ranking.
problems.repair: Correct cell and headline, define aggregation.

independent_verification.source_claim: Read p2 contribution3 and actual p13 Table1 pixels. Strongest displayed baselines are61.4,.102,.46,62.4,.055,.64 and TAGET values are63.2,.140,.98,62.9,.080,.77.
independent_verification.assumptions_verified: Comparison is relative gain versus best displayed baseline per column followed by unweighted mean over six columns, as corroborated by the other five printed percentages.
independent_verification.counterevidence: Rounding explains small other-cell differences but not a tenfold PP8 discrepancy. All six point-estimate rankings survive the correction.
independent_verification.core_dependency: Magnitude of the summary gain, not demonstrated qualitative superiority reversal.
independent_verification.severity_and_repair: Minor retained; correct PP8 to.80% and six-column mean to36.63%, with explicit aggregation.

problems.location: AppendixA p12; Fig4p7/Fig6p12; Fig3p7 versus Table1p13
problems.claim: PP configuration descriptions conflict; PromptDT table/curve correspondence is unspecified rather than a demonstrated same-checkpoint numerical contradiction.
problems.evidence: Appendix2predators4prey; real-trajectory Fig4 oneego3teammates; Fig6fourpredators8prey. PromptDTtable.64±.15 versus near-bottom curve.
problems.alternative_explanation: Stale illustration/curve or different checkpoint/table typo could explain, but not identified.

independent_verification.source_claim: Actually inspected source pp7,12,13 images and read pp6/8. AppendixA says2predators/4prey. Fig4 shows1ego+3teammates and p8 calls it a real sampled PP trajectory; Fig6 shows4predators/8prey. Suffix4/8 denotes test teammate-set count, not team size.
independent_verification.assumptions_verified: The PP mismatch is within the paper. For the return comparison, however, Table1 does not name final checkpoint or a rule that would identify its entries with final Fig3 values. An early PromptDT peak exists in Overcooked8.
independent_verification.decisive_check: Four depicted predator icons cannot simultaneously represent the stated two-agent PP configuration. Table1 gap .77-.64=.13 is exact, but a plotted training trajectory is not an equality constraint on an unspecified selected-checkpoint mean.
independent_verification.counterevidence: A stale diagram or prose configuration can explain PP without corrupting numerical trials; a selected early checkpoint/other evaluation can explain the table value. Neither alternative is identified, but neither is excluded by the source. The original report treated absent correspondence as demonstrated core-impact inconsistency.
independent_verification.core_dependency: Benchmark reconstruction is impaired; actual team size used, checkpoint identity, comparability and effect on headline evidence remain unresolved. No material core-conclusion damage is yet demonstrated.
independent_verification.severity_and_repair: Correct Major to Minor for the established PP reporting mismatch; historical return/protocol impact Needs Evidence. This correction follows admissible alternate interpretation and missing shared-estimand premise, not ease of repair. Obtain configs, checkpoints and paired returns before deciding if affected comparisons need reruns.

problems.claim: Probability/scale transforms and loss coefficient mapping missing from literal network specification.
problems.evidence: Final LeakyReLU does not ensure positive Gaussian scale or probabilities required by BCE; coefficient names unmapped.
problems.alternative_explanation: Unstated softplus/exp/sigmoid or logits loss may be implemented.
problems.dependency: Reconstruction of training algorithm; actual run failure not established.
problems.repair: Publish transformations and exact coefficients/goal targets.

independent_verification.source_claim: Read Eq4-9 pp4-5, AppendixE p14 and actual Fig7 p15. Gaussian parameters and probability-space BCE are paired with unconstrained LeakyReLU outputs and unmapped coefficient names.
independent_verification.assumptions_verified: LeakyReLU may outputnegative numbers and2. Eq8 is literal logGhat+log(1-Ghat); a Gaussian scale/covariance must satisfy positivity.
independent_verification.decisive_check: AtGhat=2,log(1-Ghat)=log(-1) is not real; negative scale outputs are not valid standard deviations/covariances. The schematic does not identify an exp/softplus/sigmoid or logits-loss transformation.
independent_verification.counterevidence: Network diagrams often omit output parameter transforms, and valid logits-based BCE/scale parameterization could have been used. Without code, actual invalid values or training failure are not established.
independent_verification.core_dependency: Precise reproduction of the high-level training objective, not proof the trained model is invalid.
independent_verification.severity_and_repair: Minor retained; publish transforms, scale convention and coefficient mapping. No actual implementation repair certified.

repair_verification: Arithmetic verified; experiment consistency and actual output parameterization require author evidence.
